question: Does a 3-second motion history improve 2-second annotated-target-change prediction relative to 1 second on exactly the same eligible windows?
anchor_policy: Keep previous pilot's exact anchors; restrict to anchors with complete 48-frame history. Both models fit and score this same intersection.
feature_definitions: net speed in recent half of history
angle between half-history displacements, unknown if either speed <0.10m/s
validation: Leave one full development run out; identical folds and person/run/window hierarchy weights for all models.
lead_lag_scope: Descriptive event-aligned motion, not prospective evaluation or causal evidence. Label-defined event time is used for alignment only.
no_tuning: No regularization search, threshold optimization, extra models, or feature selection after observing this run.
limitations: Longer-history eligibility removes early decisions; no full-cohort superiority claim.
Six summaries have different averaging timescales, so this tests this representation of longer history, not every use of memory.
Repeated participants and few events; exploratory only.
No verified geometry, neighbor visibility or global camera clock; no queue features.
